sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-4B-MLX-4bit is a compact, high-performance large language model (LLM) based on Alibaba's Qwen3.5 architecture. This version has been quantized to 4-bit precision, significantly reducing the memory footprint and compute requirements while maintaining competitive performance in text generation, reasoning, and multi-lingual tasks.
